teaser: Behaviour says what an agent may do, decision who chooses at a branch point, workflow in what order. Zoom into one ABP cell and it becomes both.
core_idea: An agent needs three policies, not one: behaviour, decision and workflow, meeting where a workflow transition is gated by a decision carried out by permitted behaviours; light decisions stay inline in the ABP, heavy ones get their own policy, and every element is mapped as defined, implemented, enforced and observed.

quotes.text: Zoom further and each of those has cells of its own.
"Decision" is the word that connects an agent's step to a budget, an owner and a risk, and that is the connection the agent's behaviour policy lacks.
